faults.name: Open conductor
faults.diagnostic: Trace continuity from source to load.

faults.name: Short circuit
faults.diagnostic: Isolate safely and identify the unintended low-impedance path.

faults.name: Overload
faults.diagnostic: Compare load current with conductor and protective-device design.

faults.name: Reverse polarity
faults.diagnostic: Verify source polarity and device pin orientation.

faults.name: Ground fault
faults.diagnostic: Use an appropriate safe test procedure; do not defeat protection.

faults.name: Phase loss
faults.diagnostic: Verify all intended phases and protection/control conditions.
